description: Details pursuant to the discharge of Condition 4 (Demolition and Construction Management plan), Condition 5 (Materials), Condition 6 (sustainable water management and water efficiency), Condition 7(i) a,b and c (contamination), Condition 10 (step free access) and Condition 11 (landscape scheme) of planning permission ref. 77586/APP/2023/2460, dated 25-03-2024 (Demolition of existing single-storey garages and the construction of 4no. 2-bedroom, two-storey houses with associated car parking and landscaping.)
application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
decision_conditions: The Applicant is advised that this decision relates to the partial discharge only of Condition 7 attached to planning permission ref. 77586/APP/2023/2460, dated 25 March 2024. Specifically, this decision notice discharges parts 7(i)(a), 7(i)(b) and 7(i)(c) only, relating to the submission of a desk-top study, site investigation and risk assessment, and a written remediation strategy and verification plan.

The requirements of Condition 7(ii), relating to the identification of any previously unidentified contamination encountered during development, and Condition 7(iii), relating to the completion of remediation works and submission of a verification report, remain outstanding and cannot be discharged until the relevant stage of development has been completed. Compliance with these remaining elements of Condition 7 is required in accordance with the wording of the condition.
